name: UnJS Logos
about: UnJS Logos is a free, open-source icon set with 63 icons designed by UnJS. Ideal for login buttons, partner walls, tech-stack badges and social links - every logo is a clean vector. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are UnJS Logos free to use?
faqs.a: The icon files themselves are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download and use. But company logos are trademarks of their owners, so always check each brand's usage guidelines before commercial use.

faqs.q: Can I use UnJS Logos logos in commercial projects?
faqs.a: You can freely download and embed the vector files under the Apache 2.0 license, but trademark law still applies: don't imply endorsement by a brand, and follow each company's brand guidelines for clear-space, colors and minimum sizes.

faqs.q: How do I use UnJS Logos in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many UnJS Logos are there?
faqs.a: There are 63 icons in the UnJS Logos set, designed by UnJS. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are UnJS Logos available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
